description: This file is a shell script containing test cases for Git operations related to branch overwriting, worktrees, fetches, rebases, and error states. It includes setup routines and multiple test scenarios verifying correct behavior and error handling when performing risky Git commands involving references and worktrees.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit with specified parameters.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case which expects successful execution.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after tests.

methods.name: test_editor_unchanged
methods.description: Checks that the editor environment is unchanged.

methods.name: set_cat_todo_editor
methods.description: Sets up the environment for editing the todo list in rebase.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite execution.
